name: Ship UI Changes Confidently with Percy

slides.transcript: A tiny UI change can create a big production surprise.

plan.beatDescription: Open with BrowserStack brand presence and immediately frame the stakes: small UI changes can break production. This sets urgency and tees up the need for visual testing.
plan.categorySearcQquery: brand introduction leading into product reliability promise
plan.voiceover: A tiny UI change can create a big production surprise.
plan.selectedTemplateDescription: Center-aligned text animates into view one letter at a time with a cascading effect. Each character slides in smoothly from the left while fading from transparent to fully visible using a soft spring motion. The animation creates a sequential, flowing reveal of the full sentence, with subtle glow and shadow for emphasis.

Background: linear-gradient(135deg, #EAF2FF 0%, #929eaf 100%).
Center a single-line message with generous margins, clean sans-serif, high-contrast text.
Reveal: subtle fade-in with a slight upward drift (8–12px) over 0.6s, then hold steady.
Add a soft underline sweep or light glint passing once beneath the text to emphasize clarity.
Keep motion minimal, calm, and readable—no extra elements or icons.
End with a brief 0.3s fade-out to transition.

plan.beatDescription: Typewriter reveal of a short greeting message
plan.selectedTemplateDescription:
Center the phrase “How are you man” in large bold sans-serif, dark navy (#1F2A44) on the gradient background.
Typewriter effect reveals letters left-to-right over 1.6s with a blinking caret after the last letter.
Caret blinks at 2Hz for 0.8s after typing completes.
Subtle 3% scale-up and 10px fade-in on the first 0.4s to add presence.
Hold final text steady for readability until end.
